research.name: Mini Map Macau
research.note: 3D map of Macau where LRT trains, buses, ferries and flights move along real routes from timetables, with a time scrubber.

effects: timetable-driven 3D vehicles (LRT, buses, ferries, aircraft) moving along real route geometry on a dark extruded city map
bottom time scrubber with 1x to 60x playback speed and a service-density strip
click-to-follow vehicle view with a per-line station timetable panel
